name: Claude Design: la IA que está reinventando el diseño
summary: Online session from Cámarabilbao on how AI design tools like Claude change visual content work.
description: A Cámarabilbao events page for an online session on 19 November at 10:00 about AI in design: generating visual pieces in minutes, adapting styles and building prototypes, aimed at businesses that have not adopted these tools yet. The page outlines what the session covers, names the speaker and takes sign-ups.
